name: max_eigenvalue_2x2
description: 2x2 SDP: max <A,X> s.t. tr(X)=1, X>=0 where A=[[2,1],[1,2]]. By the variational formula lambda_max(A) = max{<A,X>: tr(X)=1, X>=0}. Optimal X*=[[1/2,1/2],[1/2,1/2]] is RANK-1 SINGULAR (boundary optimum). Tests boundary/degenerate case.

known_gaps.reason: achieved ~74 bits/digit (final_prec 1024 for 13.9 achieved digits); rank-1 singular X*=[[1/2,1/2],[1/2,1/2]] boundary optimum, NUM status at prec 128/256/512 until 1024 reaches OPT.
